map.胃管深度(鼻尖-耳垂-剑突)测量器 使用指南: Gastric Tube Depth (Nose Tip - Ear Lobe - Xiphoid) Measuring Tool User Guide
map.按鼻尖→耳垂→剑突测量法（NEX）并结合身高公式，计算成人胃管置入深度，提升置管: Using the nose tip -> ear lobe -> xiphoid measurement (NEX) together with a height formula, compute adult gastric tube insertion depth, raising the first-attempt success rate and safety of tube placement.
map.置入深度 = 身高 × 0.2 + 鼻尖至剑突测量值: Insertion depth = height x 0.2 + the nose tip to xiphoid measurement
map.成人鼻饲置管深度取发际或鼻尖至剑突距离，常规 45–55 cm（延长至 55–6: For adults the nasogastric tube depth is the distance from the hairline or nose tip to the xiphoid, routinely 45-55 cm (extended to 55-60 cm to reduce aspiration).
map.置管后验证位置（回抽胃液/pH、听气过水声）再固定。: After placement verify the position (aspirate gastric fluid/check pH, listen for the air insufflation sound) before fixing.
map.小儿按身长比例估算并 X 线确认，避免过浅入食管。: For children estimate by body length proportion and confirm by X-ray, avoiding a tube that is too shallow and enters the oesophagus.
map.复核一例成人鼻饲管深度: Review an adult nasogastric tube depth case
map.：输入标志距 NEX=52 cm，工具给置管 52–55 cm 并提示验证位置，: : Enter the landmark distance NEX = 52 cm, and the tool gives a tube depth of 52-55 cm and reminds you to verify the position, consistent with nursing practice.
map.静脉输液滴速(微泵)换算器: Intravenous infusion drip rate (syringe pump) converter
map.造口袋更换时间(渗漏预警)计算器: Ostomy bag change time (leak warning) calculator
map.本工具能替代置管确认吗？: Can this tool replace tube placement confirmation?
map.不能，深度仅为估算，位置须回抽 pH 或影像确认。: No, the depth is only an estimate, and the position must be confirmed by aspirating and checking pH or by imaging.
map.置管后呛咳怎么办？: What if the patient coughs after tube placement?
map.疑误入气道，立即拔除重插并评估，必要时纤支镜引导。: If it is suspected to have entered the airway, remove and reinsert it immediately and reassess, using bronchoscopic guidance if necessary.
map.按身高别公式估算并以 X 线定深，不套用成人绝对值。: Estimate by a height-specific formula and set the depth by X-ray, not by copying adult absolute values.
